shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,240p' ../round-brief.md; else echo 'NO_ROUND_BRIEF'; fi
sed -n '1,260p' ../ticket.md
sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch
git log -3 --oneline
sed -n '1,220p' src/transport/ws/listSessions.test.ts
sed -n '1,260p' src/transport/ws/conversationList.test.ts 2>/dev/null || true
rg -n \"list_conversations|StoreCannotList|specs/hal-engine-conversation-list|validated by\" src specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md | head -160"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git show --stat --oneline HEAD
git show --format=fuller -- src/transport/ws/listSessions.test.ts specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md
sed -n '1,180p' src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts
rg -n \"spec-names|spec anchor|spec:\" scripts package.json .github | head -100
rg -n \"validated by\" src/transport/**/*.test.ts | head -50"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,240p' src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts
sed -n '1,180p' src/types/messages.ts
sed -n '1,150p' src/transport/ws/validation.ts
sed -n '1,130p' src/types/sessionStore.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"createMessageHandler|history|sessionStore\" src/transport/createServer.ts src/transport/connectionHandler.ts src/transport/ws/connectionHandler.ts
sed -n '1,220p' src/transport/createServer.ts
sed -n '130,210p' src/transport/ws/validation.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"// spec:|spec anchor|tests.list|descriptor\" scripts .lore | head -100
sed -n '1,120p' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs 2>/dev/null || true"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npx prettier --write src/transport/ws/listSessions.test.ts
nl -ba src/transport/ws/listSessions.test.ts | sed -n '78,140p'
node scripts/check-spec-anchor-names.mjs --fix"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short
git diff --stat
git diff -- specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md | head -100
(timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/transport/ws/listSessions.test.ts)'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'if [ -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs ]; then echo yes; else echo no; fi
git diff -- specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md
node scripts/check-spec-anchor-names.mjs'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md | sed -n '70,90p;118,130p'
rg -n \"require-spec-link|validated by\" node_modules eslint* scripts .eslintrc* package.json 2>/dev/null | head -100"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/transport/ws/listSessions.test.ts specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md
(timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/transport/ws/listSessions.test.ts)
git diff --check
git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff -- src/transport/ws/listSessions.test.ts specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md
git add src/transport/ws/listSessions.test.ts specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md && git commit -m "test(ws): repair conversation list traceability" && git push origin HEAD
git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git push origin HEAD
git status --short --branch'
